g.text: Development points average 4 stochastic writes on identity 94003. Target P&V uses 5 paired writes (seeds 94301–94305) on one sealed array 94004—not 5 arrays or confidence intervals. Adam continues exact P0 seed 94301 only. Fitted AIHWKit 1.1.0 IBM-OM · exploratory_noncanonical.
